thread:
sara_support: Customer on enterprise is hitting 404s after upgrading @redwood/sdk-node from 0.22.x -> 0.23.0. Reported behavior: chat.create returns route_not_found and some endpoints complain about unknown params.

mike_eng: Can you share the error payload + exact SDK version and server API version?

sara_support: Error copy: 
```
{"error":"Not Found","code":"route_not_found","route":"chat.create"}
```
SDK: @redwood/sdk-node@0.23.0. Server: hosted API (us-west) — customer says they didn't change anything else.

jen_customer: repro steps from our side:
1) npm i @redwood/sdk-node@0.23.0
2) node test.js with:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'redwood-alpha-1', sessionId: 's-123', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'hello' }] });
```
Response: 400 Unknown parameter: "sessionId" (server suggests "session_id") or sometimes 404 route_not_found.

mike_eng: Hmm — two separate issues possibly: 1) route rename on server-side vs SDK expecting old name, 2) param casing change (camelCase -> snake_case). We recently rolled an API change that normalized param names and consolidated chat routes. There should have been a compatibility shim.

ankit_dev: Taking a look. Can you also run with DEBUG=rw:api to show request path + body? That will confirm if SDK is calling the new route or the old one.

jen_customer: Here's debug output (trimmed):
```
REQUEST POST /v1/chat.create
BODY: { model: 'redwood-alpha-1', sessionId: 's-123', messages: [...] }
```
Server responded 404.

mike_eng: Okay SDK is still hitting /v1/chat.create and sending camelCase sessionId. On the server we switched to /v1/chat with action=create and snake_case params. The SDK release should have transformed, but looks like the packaging omitted the shim in 0.23.0.

sara_support: Customer wants a workaround — they are on prod, can't change code easily.

ankit_dev: Short-term workaround: pin @redwood/sdk-node@0.22.5 which preserves old route/params. I can also push a hotfix in the SDK that maps old->new at runtime so both forms work. I'll prioritize a 0.23.1 patch.

mike_eng: Also need a server-side fallback for one week to accept legacy route/params while customers migrate. Can ops add a temporary proxy rule?

deploy-bot: Incident created: RW-INC-4123 — legacy-route-fallback requested by eng.

ankit_dev: Filing SDK bug: GH#5823. Patch plan: detect presence of camelCase keys (sessionId, userId) and transform to snake_case; if path is chat.create, map to /v1/chat?action=create. Add integration tests.

doc-bot: Noted — docs update required: migration guide for 0.23.0 (param casing + route mapping).

sara_support: Communicating to customer: advising pin to 0.22.5 and ETA for SDK hotfix + server fallback.

jen_customer: Confirmed pinning to 0.22.5 immediately fixed our test sandbox. Thanks — please keep us posted.

mike_eng: Follow-ups: (1) ankit to cut 0.23.1 with compatibility shim within 12 hours; (2) eng-ops add proxy fallback for 72 hours; (3) docs & changelog to make migration explicit.

ankit_dev: Working on patch now. Will post PR and a minimal repro script.

sara_support: I'll update the customer and mark as escalated.

jen_customer: QA will re-test once you confirm the patch.

mike_eng: Thanks all. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
